entries.odia: ଷାଠିଏ ବାଟି ନାହାକିଆଣୀ ପରର ବାଡ଼ି ପନ୍ଦାଡ଼ରେ ମାଗି ଖାଉଛି
entries.title: Land and a meal from elsewhere
entries.literal_meaning: The woman with sixty bāṭi of land asks for food at another’s yard or veranda.
entries.explanation: The dictionary defines a woman with extensive landholdings. The quotation sets that description beside asking and eating elsewhere. Our reading notices a gap between an imposing description of possessions and the immediate means of obtaining a meal. It leaves the reason open rather than declaring the woman dishonest or undeserving.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ବହୁ ଜମିର ଅଧିକାରିଣୀ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଉଦ୍ଧୃତି ସେହି ପରିଚୟ ପାଖରେ ପରଘରେ ମାଗି ଖାଇବାକୁ ରଖେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତିର ବଡ଼ ପରିଚୟ ଓ ସେହି ବେଳର ଖାଇବା ଯୋଗାଡ଼ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ ଦିଶେ। ଏହାର କାରଣ ଖୋଲା ରହେ; ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଜଣକ ଠକ ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟର ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଆମେ ରାୟ ଦେଉନାହୁଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading distinguishes possessions from the meal immediately available.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ଓ ସେହି ବେଳର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଯୋଗାଡ଼କୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: କଥାଟି ପଢ଼ି ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଜମି ଅଛି ବୋଲି ସେହି ବେଳେ ଖାଇବା ଅଛି କି?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ଏଠି କାରଣଟା ଲେଖାନାହିଁ।” / Two readers distinguish owning land from having a meal available and leave the missing explanation unresolved. Their discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The female landowner is the source’s subject. Bāṭi is retained without conversion; the line establishes neither a historical person nor a cause of her request.
